angelo: Ack. Which services are in canary?
maya: Canary: internal-dev, beta, and ~8% prod traffic in eu-west. Routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat.
ops-eng: Embeddings on separate pool; we will not touch embed-* in this window.
sre_oncall: I'll publish status notice: "Prediction endpoints may see brief latency increases; no data loss expected."
deploy-bot: Job scheduled: kv-reshuffle-2026-04-05-02:00 UTC. CI passed.
maya: Rollback if 5xx > 1% sustained for 15m or KV hit-rate < 80% after 10m. Quiet window 01:45-03:45 UTC; defer noncritical batch jobs.
angelo: I'll monitor canary dashboards and coordinate rollback if needed.
